SELECT c.id, c.work_id AS "workId" FROM chapters c JOIN works w ON w.id = c.work_id
    WHERE 
  w.publication_status = 'published'
  AND w.synopsis IS NOT NULL AND w.author IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM work_categories wc JOIN categories category ON category.id = wc.category_id
    WHERE wc.work_id = w.id AND category.enabled)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_references reference JOIN media_assets asset ON asset.id = reference.asset_id
    WHERE reference.work_id = w.id AND reference.slot = 'work_cover' AND reference.retired_at IS NULL
      AND asset.media_class = 'work_cover' AND asset.scope = 'admin' AND asset.status = 'available')
 AND 
  c.publication_status = 'published'
  AND c.published_at IS NOT NULL
  AND c.current_publication_event_id IS NOT NULL
  AND 
  (c.title IS NOT NULL AND btrim(c.title) <> '' AND c.number > 0 AND
        CASE WHEN c.content_type = 'text' THEN
          
  jsonb_typeof(c.text_content) = 'object'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(
  CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(c.text_content) = 'object' THEN c.text_content ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
) AS field(key)
    WHERE field.key NOT IN ($1,$2)
  )
  AND c.text_content->'version' = '1'::jsonb
  AND jsonb_typeof(c.text_content->'blocks') = 'array'
  AND jsonb_array_length(
  CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(c.text_content->'blocks') = 'array' THEN c.text_content->'blocks' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
) BETWEEN 1 AND 500
  AND octet_length(c.text_content::text) <= 524288
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(
  CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(c.text_content->'blocks') = 'array' THEN c.text_content->'blocks' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
) AS block(value)
    WHERE (jsonb_typeof(block.value) = 'object' AND CASE block.value->>'type'
      WHEN 'heading' THEN 
  NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(
  CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(block.value) = 'object' THEN block.value ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
) AS field(key)
    WHERE field.key NOT IN ($3,$4,$5)
  )
  AND block.value->'level' IN ('2'::jsonb, '3'::jsonb)
  AND 
    jsonb_typeof(block.value->'text') = 'string'
    AND length((block.value->'text' #>> '{}')) >= 1 AND CASE
    WHEN length((block.value->'text' #>> '{}')) > $6 THEN false
    WHEN octet_length((block.value->'text' #>> '{}')) = length((block.value->'text' #>> '{}')) THEN true
    ELSE length((block.value->'text' #>> '{}')) + (
      SELECT count(*) FROM regexp_matches((block.value->'text' #>> '{}'), '[\s\S]', 'g') AS glyph(characters)
      WHERE ascii((glyph.characters)[1]) > 65535
    ) <= $7
  END
    AND replace(replace(replace(replace((block.value->'text' #>> '{}'), chr(9), ''), chr(10), ''), chr(13), ''), chr(127), '') !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
  

      WHEN 'paragraph' THEN 
  NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(
  CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(block.value) = 'object' THEN block.value ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
) AS field(key)
    WHERE field.key NOT IN ($8,$9)
  )
  AND jsonb_typeof(block.value->'content') = 'array'
  AND jsonb_array_length(
  CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(block.value->'content') = 'array' THEN block.value->'content' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
) BETWEEN 1 AND 200
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(
  CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(block.value->'content') = 'array' THEN block.value->'content' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
) AS inline_node(value)
    WHERE (
  jsonb_typeof(inline_node.value) = 'object'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(
  CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(inline_node.value) = 'object' THEN inline_node.value ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
) AS field(key)
    WHERE field.key NOT IN ($10,$11,$12,$13)
  )
  AND 
    jsonb_typeof(inline_node.value->'text') = 'string'
    AND length((inline_node.value->'text' #>> '{}')) >= 1 AND CASE
    WHEN length((inline_node.value->'text' #>> '{}')) > $14 THEN false
    WHEN octet_length((inline_node.value->'text' #>> '{}')) = length((inline_node.value->'text' #>> '{}')) THEN true
    ELSE length((inline_node.value->'text' #>> '{}')) + (
      SELECT count(*) FROM regexp_matches((inline_node.value->'text' #>> '{}'), '[\s\S]', 'g') AS glyph(characters)
      WHERE ascii((glyph.characters)[1]) > 65535
    ) <= $15
  END
    AND replace(replace(replace(replace((inline_node.value->'text' #>> '{}'), chr(9), ''), chr(10), ''), chr(13), ''), chr(127), '') !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
  
  AND (NOT inline_node.value ? 'bold' OR jsonb_typeof(inline_node.value->'bold') = 'boolean')
  AND (NOT inline_node.value ? 'italic' OR jsonb_typeof(inline_node.value->'italic') = 'boolean')
  AND (NOT inline_node.value ? 'href' OR 
    jsonb_typeof(inline_node.value->'href') = 'string'
    AND length((inline_node.value->'href' #>> '{}')) >= 1 AND CASE
    WHEN length((inline_node.value->'href' #>> '{}')) > $16 THEN false
    WHEN octet_length((inline_node.value->'href' #>> '{}')) = length((inline_node.value->'href' #>> '{}')) THEN true
    ELSE length((inline_node.value->'href' #>> '{}')) + (
      SELECT count(*) FROM regexp_matches((inline_node.value->'href' #>> '{}'), '[\s\S]', 'g') AS glyph(characters)
      WHERE ascii((glyph.characters)[1]) > 65535
    ) <= $17
  END
    AND left((inline_node.value->'href' #>> '{}'), 1) = '/' AND left((inline_node.value->'href' #>> '{}'), 2) <> '//'
    AND strpos((inline_node.value->'href' #>> '{}'), chr(92)) = 0 AND (inline_node.value->'href' #>> '{}') !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
  )
) IS NOT TRUE
  )

      WHEN 'list' THEN 
  NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(
  CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(block.value) = 'object' THEN block.value ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
) AS field(key)
    WHERE field.key NOT IN ($18,$19,$20)
  )
  AND jsonb_typeof(block.value->'ordered') = 'boolean'
  AND jsonb_typeof(block.value->'items') = 'array'
  AND jsonb_array_length(
  CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(block.value->'items') = 'array' THEN block.value->'items' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
) BETWEEN 1 AND 200
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(
  CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(block.value->'items') = 'array' THEN block.value->'items' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
) AS list_item(value)
    WHERE (
    jsonb_typeof(list_item.value) = 'string'
    AND length((list_item.value #>> '{}')) >= 1 AND CASE
    WHEN length((list_item.value #>> '{}')) > $21 THEN false
    WHEN octet_length((list_item.value #>> '{}')) = length((list_item.value #>> '{}')) THEN true
    ELSE length((list_item.value #>> '{}')) + (
      SELECT count(*) FROM regexp_matches((list_item.value #>> '{}'), '[\s\S]', 'g') AS glyph(characters)
      WHERE ascii((glyph.characters)[1]) > 65535
    ) <= $22
  END
    AND replace(replace(replace(replace((list_item.value #>> '{}'), chr(9), ''), chr(10), ''), chr(13), ''), chr(127), '') !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
  ) IS NOT TRUE
  )

      ELSE false END) IS NOT TRUE
  )

        WHEN c.content_type = 'illustrated' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chapter_pages p
          WHERE p.chapter_id = c.id AND p.retired_at IS NULL)
          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chapter_pages p
            WHERE p.chapter_id = c.id AND p.retired_at IS NULL AND
              (p.position < 1 OR
                (SELECT count(*) FROM media_references r
                  WHERE r.chapter_page_id = p.id AND r.retired_at IS NULL) <> 1 OR
                NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_references r
                  JOIN media_assets a ON a.id = r.asset_id
                  WHERE r.chapter_page_id = p.id AND r.retired_at IS NULL
                    AND r.slot = 'chapter_page' AND a.media_class = 'chapter_page'
                    AND a.scope = 'admin' AND a.status = 'available')))
          AND (SELECT count(*) FROM chapter_pages p
            WHERE p.chapter_id = c.id AND p.retired_at IS NULL) BETWEEN 1 AND 500
          AND (SELECT count(*) FROM chapter_pages p
            WHERE p.chapter_id = c.id AND p.retired_at IS NULL) =
              (SELECT max(p.position) FROM chapter_pages p
                WHERE p.chapter_id = c.id AND p.retired_at IS NULL)
        ELSE false
        END)


    ORDER BY c.published_at DESC, c.id ASC LIMIT 12
